name: Data Table
tagline: A sortable, pageable table over any Dataverse view, with row selection.

limitations: Paging is inert. The demo harness puts every fixture row on a single page and reports hasNextPage and hasPreviousPage as false, so Next and Previous render disabled and loadNextPage() only re-renders the same rows. The page size property does nothing either, because the harness’s setPageSize() is an empty function.

Sorting a column moves the sort arrow but does not reorder the rows. The control writes into dataset.sorting and calls refresh(), which is what a real view needs because sorting is applied server-side across every page — but the harness rebuilds the dataset with an empty sorting array on each render and discards the request.

Clicking a row calls dataset.openDatasetItem(), which the harness logs as a mock call: there is no Dataverse behind this origin and no form to open. The openedRecordId output still updates, so the value a form would react to is visible.

Rows tick and untick, but dataset.setSelectedRecordIds() does not survive a re-render for the same reason sorting does not. What you see is the control’s own copy of the selection. On a model-driven form that same call is what tells the command bar which records the ribbon acts on.

presets.name: Default
presets.description: A 24-row view with sortable columns and multi-row selection.
